Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The PR changes geometry conversion and holder envelopes used for collision checks.

The STEP alignment refusals, undo and redo tests, and existing DXF tests pass. The trial merge with upstream/main (`a277dd9d51e7b4488403b946d0a3234b71ba7504`) needs no changes. Main is already an ancestor of this head.

Requested before merge:

1. **Safety: preserve clockwise major arcs.** `crates/app/src/tool_profile_dxf_import.rs:146` splits only positive sweeps greater than PI. The DXF reader can return negative sweeps from LWPOLYLINE bulges. The importer then replaces a clockwise major arc with a minor arc. This can remove holder material from collision checks.

   Reproduction: use millimetres and a centreline from `(0,0)` to `(0,80)`. Add one open LWPOLYLINE with these `(x,y,bulge)` vertices: `(0,55,0)`, `(10,55,-2.414213562373095)`, `(15,60,0)`, `(0,60,0)`. The reader returns an arc with centre `(10,60)`, radius `5`, and sweep `-3*PI/2`. That arc reaches Z=65. However, `dxf_to_spun` accepts a profile whose top is Z=60. Handle both sweep signs before conversion. Refuse this axial reversal by name. Add a regression test that checks the source arc extent.

2. **Add UI evidence.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_profile_page.rs:141` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_body_page.rs:154` add visible controls and notices. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. Add screenshots for the Profile and Body tabs. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the PR body.

Local verification:

All commands ran locally in the foreground with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache`. No GitHub runner was used.

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --test dxf_writer` | 2 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-tools --lib spun::envelope` | 1 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_dxf_profile --test tool_dxf_profile_mcp` | 6 profile tests and 1 MCP test passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` from `crates/ui` | 861 passed, 6 ignored |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --test dxf --test dxf_refusals` | 16 parser tests and 15 refusal tests passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |

The temporary clockwise-arc regression test failed with this message:

```text
clockwise major arc reaches z=65 but accepted profile truncates it
```

I repeated two of the PR's mutation checks:

- Radius merge `max(r)` to `min(r)`: `thirty_two_distinct_bands_reduce_conservatively_to_spun_profile` failed, exit 101. After restoration, the test passed.

  ```text
  at 28: shrunk 10 < 10.5
  ```

- Centreline-crossing guard bypass: `dxf_half_profile_error_refusals_never_panic_and_name_reasons` failed, exit 101. After restoration, the test passed. The diagnostic changed to:

  ```text
  DXF half-profile invalid: point 3 has a negative radius
  ```

I restored all temporary edits. The worktree is clean. The PR changes no NC/CL goldens or UI snapshot PNGs.

Native file-picker dialogs were not exercised. Release-only heavy suites were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed both findings from the review of 47cfd082f.

1. Major DXF arcs now split for either sweep sign before conversion. Clockwise arcs retain their full extent and the supplied axial reversal is refused by name. `dxf_major_bulge_arc_extent_is_preserved_and_axial_reversal_is_named` pins both windings, the source arc reaching Z=65, and the refusal. Removing `abs()` made this test RED by accepting a truncated Z=60 profile. Restoring it made the test GREEN.

2. Added before/after screenshots for the Profile and Body tabs to the PR body. All four images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at 79de292fc0a701e7f81ab588f29aebac4bbd5b86. The capture harness checked that the controls were absent before and present after. The existing `profile_tab_states_conservative_envelope_and_half_profile_rules_and_dxf_workflow` and `body_tab_convert_to_profile_refuses_unaligned_step_and_converts_iso_aligned_step` pins pass. No screenshots or capture code were added to this PR branch.

New head: 02c8aaa7079f3d0bef55a3e7eab790c1826583e2.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed all 10 steps after expanding to batch. Clippy passed on all touched crates with `--all-targets -- -D warnings`. The PR remains a draft. Please re-review this head.

Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The PR changes holder geometry used in collision checks. I checked the rules in current upstream main, `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6`.

Both earlier findings are resolved:

- Major arcs now split for both sweep signs. The new test checks the source arc extent and the named refusal for axial reversal. Removing `abs()` makes the test fail. Restoring it makes the test pass.
- The PR body has before and after images for the Profile and Body tabs. I opened all four images. They show the new controls and notices. The images are on the fork's images-only branch. This PR adds no images.

Requested before merge:

1. **Move the DXF importer to a domain crate.** `crates/app/src/tool_profile_dxf_import.rs:9` imports only geometry values, tool profile values and a layer-name constant. The whole module parses, orders and projects domain values. It does not read or write the ECS world, a project file, a command, MCP or the CLI. This breaks current upstream `AGENTS.md`, **app holds the document, nothing else**. Move this conversion code to the domain layer and keep an app re-export or facade. Keep the world and command work in `SetToolBody`. Put tests of the moved domain code in the lowest crate that provides its imports. If the move needs a new crate dependency, record that dependency as the rules require.

Local results, with the PR trial-merged with current upstream main:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge | Clean; no conflict resolution needed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --test dxf_writer --test dxf --test dxf_refusals` | 2 writer, 16 parser and 15 refusal tests passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-tools --lib spun` | 8 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test tool_dxf_profile --test tool_dxf_profile_mcp` | 7 profile and 1 MCP test passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui` | 895 passed; 6 ignored |
| Clippy on geometry, tools, app and UI, `--all-targets -- -D warnings` | Failed on the unchanged upstream constant below |
| Same clippy command, with `-A dead_code` after `-D warnings` | Passed |

The strict clippy failure is in current upstream main. The PR does not change this file. It is separate from the requested change above:

```text
error: constant `MIN_LABEL_PX` is never used
   --> crates/ui/src/egui_app/painted.rs:115:11
115 | pub const MIN_LABEL_PX: f32 = 10.0;
```

I repeated these mutations locally. Each test failed with exit 101 after the mutation and passed with exit 0 after restoration:

- Band merge radius `max(r)` to `min(r)`: `thirty_two_distinct_bands_reduce_conservatively_to_spun_profile`. Failure: `at 28: shrunk 10 < 10.5`.
- Zero-length LINE guard bypass: `writer_refuses_invalid_inputs_by_name`. The writer accepted an invalid LINE.
- Major-arc split without `abs()`: `dxf_major_bulge_arc_extent_is_preserved_and_axial_reversal_is_named`. The importer accepted a truncated Z=60 profile for an arc that reaches Z=65.

All temporary mutations are restored. No contributor code was committed or pushed. No NC/CL golden files or UI snapshot PNGs changed, so there are no moved goldens to check line by line.

All builds and tests ran locally in the foreground with `RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache`. No GitHub runner was used. The quick-gate dry run selects the batch tier because geometry changed; that full batch was not run in this review. Native file-picker dialogs and release-only heavy tests were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
